gloss: closing word of a letter begun with {前略|ぜんりゃく}

definitions.gloss: closing word of a brief letter (pairs with {前略|ぜんりゃく})
definitions.explanation: A letter closing meaning "in haste," written at the end of a letter that opened with {前略|ぜんりゃく} or {冠省|かんしょう}.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧「{草々|そうそう}」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{書|か}いた→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: I wrote sōsō at the end.

examples.japanese: ⟦{前略|ぜんりゃく}→前略：32015_zenryaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{始|はじ}めたなら、⟦{手紙|てがみ}→手紙：00675_tegami⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{終|お}わり→終わり：01361_owari⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{敬具|けいぐ}→敬具：12977_keigu⟧⟦ではなく→ではなく：09578_dehanaku⟧{草々|そうそう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: If you open with zenryaku, end the letter with sōsō, not keigu.

notes:
Written on its own line at the bottom right of a vertical letter. It apologizes for writing briefly and in haste, matching the informality of ⟦{前略|ぜんりゃく}→前略：32015_zenryaku⟧. Also written {匆々|そうそう}.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{前略|ぜんりゃく}→前略：32015_zenryaku⟧ … {草々|そうそう}: brief letters
- ⟦{拝啓|はいけい}→拝啓：12790_haikei⟧ … ⟦{敬具|けいぐ}→敬具：12977_keigu⟧: standard formal letters

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{早々|そうそう}→早々：12959_sousou⟧: early; as soon as (a different word with the same reading)
- かしこ: closing word used by women in any letter
